summaryZh: AP公司发布FeedSense饲料库存监测系统，采用光学传感器自动监测猪场料塔余量，支持低料位和加料自动报警，并提供历史消耗趋势分析以辅助采购和饲料转化率评估。系统集成太阳能板和可充电电池，无需依赖猪舍供电，防尘防水抗紫外线，可快速改装安装于现有波纹料塔，每次读数附带料塔内部图像，数据通过AP Connect应用传输。
featuredReason: 该产品直击猪场饲料管理痛点，以低成本的太阳能离网方案实现料塔库存自动监测与预警，附带内部图像和消耗趋势分析，对规模化猪场降低人工巡检成本、优化饲料采购和转化率具有直接参考价值。

AP launches new FeedSense system to monitor swine feed inventory

Operates independently of barn power using an integrated solar panel and a rechargeable battery for off-grid reliability.

Industry ReleaseSeptember 11, 2026

schedule1 Min Read

AP

Low feed levels in a swine barn can compromise pig health and productivity. To help ensure proper nutrition, the new FeedSense system from AP (Automated Production) automatically monitors feed bin levels with high accuracy and minimal maintenance.

FeedSense uses modern optical sensors for remote feed inventory monitoring. The system sends automated alerts when feed levels are low or feed is added to the bin. Historical trends are also provided, storing consumption patterns to support forecasting, ordering and feed conversion analysis.

“Our new FeedSense technology supports a range of corrugated bulk feed tanks and is built for harsh agricultural environments, including being dustproof, waterproof and UV-resistant,” adds Alvarim Costa, AP senior product owner.

Costa said other features include:

Easy retrofit installation, able to mount to existing feed bins with minimal tools and no structural modifications.

Operates independently of barn power using an integrated solar panel and a rechargeable battery for off-grid reliability.

Every FeedSense reading includes an image captured from inside the bin for visibility of bin conditions without having to climb the side of the feed bin to look inside.

Related:Sensaphone launches three livestock facility monitoring systems

FeedSense transmits data through the AP Connect app. For more information, producers can contact their local AP dealer or visit the website.

translationZh:
猪舍饲料水平过低会损害猪只健康和生产效率。为帮助确保适当的营养供给，AP（Automated Production）公司推出的全新FeedSense系统能够以高精度和极低维护量自动监测料塔饲料水平。

FeedSense采用现代光学传感器进行远程饲料库存监测。当饲料水平过低或有饲料加入料塔时，系统会自动发送警报。系统还提供历史趋势数据，存储消耗模式以支持预测、订购和饲料转化率分析。

“我们的新FeedSense技术支持多种波纹散装饲料料塔，专为恶劣的农业环境设计，具备防尘、防水和抗紫外线特性，”AP高级产品负责人Alvarim Costa补充道。

Costa表示其他功能包括：

**便捷改装安装**，能够以最少的工具安装到现有料塔上，无需结构改造。

**独立于猪舍供电运行**，采用集成太阳能板和可充电电池，实现离网可靠性。

**每次FeedSense读数都包含料塔内部拍摄的图像**，无需攀爬料塔侧面即可查看料塔内部状况。

相关阅读：Sensaphone推出三款畜牧设施监测系统

FeedSense通过AP Connect应用传输数据。如需了解更多信息，生产者可联系当地AP经销商或访问网站。
